main.description: A recording of a song or musical work: the performance captured in a specific format

isrc.description: ISRC (International Standard Recording Code) with which the recording is registered

duration.description: Duration of the recording in seconds

audioFile.description: Reference to the access-controlled audio file stored in the owner's atproto space.

audioFileRef.description: Pointer to a ch.indiemusi.alpha.audioFile record in the owner's private space. Requires a space credential from the owner's PDS to retrieve the audio blob.

ownerDid.description: DID of the user whose space hosts the audio file record.

spaceSkey.description: Space key of the ch.indiemusi.alpha.audioLibrary space holding this file. Corresponds to the rkey of the associated release record.

rkey.description: Record key of the ch.indiemusi.alpha.audioFile record within the space.

mimeType.description: MIME type hint, e.g. audio/flac. Allows display without fetching the space record.

artist.description: Information about an artist contributing to the recording
